items.quote: And he said, Cast it on the ground.
items.claim: The text says an unnamed speaker ('he') told the person he was speaking to to throw 'it' on the ground.
items.action: commanded to cast it on the ground

items.quote: And he cast it on the ground, and it became a serpent
items.claim: The text says the object was thrown on the ground and turned into a serpent. This is what the passage reports, not a checked historical event.
items.action: cast it on the ground; it became a serpent
items.mechanism: narrated transformation after being thrown to the ground

items.quote: and Moses fled from before it.
items.claim: The text says Moses ran away from the serpent. Model-prior (not confirmed): this verse is Exodus 4:3 and the object is Moses' rod or staff. The document itself does not name the object or the book.
